title: "core/write-text"

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs. Edit the repository definition and its Markdown documentation. -->

Create a text file from a parameter.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name      | Default      | Description                |
| --------- | ------------ | -------------------------- |
| `content` | **Required** | Exact UTF-8 file contents. |

## Outputs

| Name   | Kind | Description                            |
| ------ | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| `file` | file | Text file containing content verbatim. |

## Execution

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Environment  | Rugix Bakery |
| Source epoch | Consumed     |
| Output cache | Allowed      |

## Behavior

Write the `content` parameter to a file without adding a newline. Compositions
can use its `file` output to turn configurable text into a file input for
another rule.

## Example

For example, define a configuration file:

```toml
uses = "core/write-text"
parameters.content = """
[all]
enable_uart=1
"""
```

Save the invocation as `build-rule.toml` and run
`./run-bakery bake rule build-rule.toml build/result`. The exported file is
`build/result/file`.
